name: Ai Robotics Inc.
summary: Ai Robotics Inc. engages in advertising business in Japan. The company offers SELL, an AI system that automates advertising operations, operates video distribution service related to lifestyles for women and distributes advertisements through the service. It also sells skincare products, beauty appliances, hair dryers, and other products under the Yunth, Brighte, Straine, LOEM TOKYO, ELEKI BRUSH, and SHOWER DRYER brand names. The company was formerly known as HowTwo! Inc. and changed its name to Ai Robotics Inc. in July 2020. Ai Robotics Inc. was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
